_comment: Bounded live coexistence scenarios, not a trigger-rate or regex-only behavior eval set. Run in isolated scratch sessions with both plugin skill catalogs available. Compare the prior snapshot with the candidate using identical prompts, then review held-out cases. Inject actual runtime bootstrap context for bootstrap cases; direct-mind-spark cases load that skill body before the prompt to exercise an incidental focused entry. prior_context is an evaluator-supplied conversation summary, not a claim about a real prior user session. No writes, installation, configuration changes, or git mutations are part of these scenarios.
review_requirements: Record the actual model and reasoning selection, runtime version, bootstrap delivery mechanism, both plugin revisions, command exit status, and full transcript.

Prove phase skill activation with a qualified native Skill event in Claude Code or the selected catalog entry's exact SKILL.md read in Codex. A prose promise or a skill name echoed from the prompt is not activation.
The expected phase skill must own the substantive action. An incidental router or mind-spark load must exit before executing a competing phase checklist.

Reject a second plugin's procedure for the same phase, including a house completion checklist appended to a Superpowers-owned phase. Owner choice must not disable hooks, permissions, or evidence requirements.

Generate a review artifact before assigning a verdict. Separate model behavior under supplied bootstrap context from native installed-plugin bootstrap delivery; do not claim native delivery from supplied context.
Resume scenarios validate owner preservation against the supplied conversation summary. Native resume or compact support additionally requires an actual resumed runtime transcript.
